name: nour-islamic-chat
description: Application web de chat islamique avec IA — gratuite et open source

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test: cd client && node --import tsx --test src/lib/markdown.test.tsx src/lib/geocode.test.ts src/lib/readingPosition.test.ts src/lib/storageScope.test.ts src/lib/chatSync.test.ts src/lib/spacedRepetition.test.ts src/lib/nameOfTheDay.test.ts src/lib/nameQuran.test.ts src/lib/countdown.test.ts src/lib/eventCountdown.test.ts src/lib/dhulHijjah.test.ts src/lib/eventQuizzes.test.ts src/lib/chatThinking.test.ts && cd .. && node --import tsx --test server/src/lib/pgSql.test.ts server/src/routes/streak.test.ts server/src/routes/badges.test.ts server/src/routes/conversations.test.ts server/src/routes/auth.test.ts server/src/routes/quests.test.ts server/src/routes/challenges.test.ts server/src/routes/achievements.test.ts server/src/routes/models.test.ts server/src/services/thinkingFilter.test.ts
